skill_name: Generate a list of 10 items one would need to prepare a simple sandwich
workflow:
1. Bread
2. Meat
3. Cheese
4. Condiments (ketchup, mustard, etc)
5. Vegetables (lettuce, tomato, onion, etc)
6. Utensils (knife, cutting board, etc)
7. Plate
8. Napkins
9. Mayonnaise
10. Butter or margarine
